title: TRUNK-6701: Avoid redundant per-request session attribute writes in OpenmrsFilter
body:
<!--- Add a pull request title above in this format -->
<!--- real example: 'TRUNK-5111: Replace use of deprecated isVoided' -->
<!--- 'TRUNK-JiraIssueNumber: JiraIssueTitle' -->
## Description of what I changed
<!--- Describe your changes in detail -->
<!--- It can simply be your commit message, which you must have -->

Avoid redundant session attribute writes in `OpenmrsFilter` by only updating `username` and `locale` when their values have changed.

This also prevents authenticated requests from first writing the anonymous username before overwriting it with the authenticated username.

## Changes

- Updated `OpenmrsFilter` to conditionally write `username` and `locale` session attributes.
- Calculate the username before updating the session to avoid the intermediate anonymous username write.
- Added tests covering:
  - Initial anonymous requests.
  - Repeated anonymous requests with unchanged attributes.
  - Initial authenticated requests.
  - Repeated authenticated requests with unchanged attributes.
  - Updating session attributes when their existing values have changed.
